subject: Lift & Verify: Edge VPC postflight playbook
messages:
From: Anna Price <anna.price@acme-corp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lift & Verify: Edge VPC postflight playbook

Marcus —

Thanks for standing this up last week. Before we flip full traffic to the new edge VPC I'd like to run a concise postflight (post-deploy) verification so our SRE and networking teams have the same checklist. High level asks:

- Confirm KV cache priming for the forecast workload (3-minute warmup observed in staging).
- Validate cross-region ingress routing and any NAT gateway sticky behaviors.
- KMS reachability from private subnet (rotate test key).
- Confirm ACLs match the agreed 10.1.0.0/16 allowlist and no accidental 0.0.0.0/0 egress.
- Run a short canary that exercises streaming + function-calls path (50 concurrent sessions for 10 mins).

I've attached our Acme-side \"postflight checklist\" and a short list of test endpoints we use. Ideally we'd do the verification window Wed 6/9 14:00-15:30 PT with results posted to the ticket. Can you confirm owners and any gotchas we should expect?

Attachments: postflight_acme_checklist_v1.pdf (attached)

—Anna
Anna Price
Cloud Ops Manager, Acme Cloud Services
anna.price@acme-corp.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Price <anna.price@acme-corp.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lift & Verify: Edge VPC postflight playbook

Anna / team —

Thanks, Anna. We'll take the lead on the playbook and pair with Acme for the canary window. Proposed plan below (short and executable):

1) Owners and roles
   - Network checks / ACL verification — Connor O'Brien (network eng)
   - KMS / key rotation reachability — Jasmine Liu (security infra)
   - KV priming + runtime warmup — Mina Haddad (runtime ops)
   - Canary orchestration + traffic steering — Marcus Lin (platform eng)

2) Timing
   - Wed 2027-06-09 14:00 PT — begin preflight (30m)
   - 14:30 PT — start 10-min canary (50 concurrent sessions)
   - 14:45 PT — quick triage window (15m)
   - 15:00 PT — declare GO / hold / rollback decision

3) Quick smoke checklist (we'll record pass/fail in the Jira ticket INF-2749):
   - Control plane reachable from customer VPC (SSH/HTTPS as applicable)
   - KMS key rotation test successful (decrypt + encrypt roundtrip)
   - KV cache hit-rate target >= 60% after warmup period
   - Ingress latency < 120ms p95 for canary requests
   - No ACL violations detected (automated diff + manual spot check)

4) Artifacts and links
   - Postflight runbook (attached): postflight_runbook_v3.pdf
   - Ticket: INF-2749
   - Drive: postflight playbook v3 (link below)

Any objections to the timeline? If not, Connor / Mina / Jasmine, I'll go ahead and schedule the ops bridge for 14:00 PT and invite Acme.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Price <anna.price@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lift & Verify: Edge VPC postflight playbook

Marcus —

Looks good. One small ask on the KV priming step: rather than a single 3-minute warmup, let's do a staged priming (2x 90s ramps) to surface any cache eviction anomalies. Also adding a smoke check for sequential tokenization / chunking behavior on the function-calls path — in staging we saw one edge VM drop at ~30s under steady streaming which I want to validate isn't present in prod.

I'll prepare a short script to run the priming ramps and publish results (stdout + summary) to the ticket. Recommend we set the canary to 12 minutes (start at 14:30, stop at 14:42) so we get a clean 10-minute steady-state after ramp.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Runtime Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Anna Price <anna.price@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lift & Verify: Edge VPC postflight playbook — preflight network checks

Quick preflight snapshot before bridge:

- ACL diff vs approved policy: clean (no extra prefixes).
- Route table sanity: public-to-private translations verified.
- NAT gateway sticky session variance: samples within expected window.
- p95 latency to edge ingress endpoints from Acme probe: 98ms
- p99 observed with small spike at 180ms (trace attached)

Attaching sample results: network-latency-results.csv (first 1k lines) — we pushed a quick traceroute and ICMP probes from three zones. No immediate red flags but will continue monitoring during the canary.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Network Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Price <anna.price@acme-corp.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Postflight summary: Edge VPC verification complete

Team / Anna —

Thanks everyone for the bridge and execution today. Summary:

- KV priming: passed. Mina's staged warmups reached a steady-state hit-rate of 68% after the second ramp (above our 60% target).
- KMS key test: Jasmine validated encrypt/decrypt across private subnets; no latency regressions observed.
- Network checks: Connor's preflight was accurate; we saw one transient p99 spike during the canary (180ms) tied to a noisy path in zone-b — we rerouted and spike resolved. See attached CSV for timestamps.
- Canary: 50 concurrent streaming sessions for 12 minutes; p95 latency 110ms, p99 185ms (one reconnection event accounted for the p99). Function calling path exercised; no stream drops at steady-state.
- ACL / routing: automated diff + manual sample checks OK. No 0.0.0.0/0 leaks.

Decision: GO for full traffic switch at 18:00 PT tonight. We will monitor the first 2 hours with an elevated pager and do a 24h health check tomorrow 17:30 PT.

Action items:
- Connor: continue 15-min monitoring pulses for next 2 hours and post updates to INF-2749.
- Mina: run a warmup replay at +1h to keep cache warm as traffic ramps.
- Jasmine: confirm KMS audit logs capture the rotate event and share snapshot.

Attachments: postflight_runbook_v3.pdf (finalized), network-latency-results.csv

If anything emerges we escalate on the bridge. Otherwise, signing off until the 24h check-in.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
